description: Copy a campaign with its ad squads (and optionally ads) into a NEW campaign. Everything is created PAUSED and re-timed to start shortly after enabling. Daily and lifetime budgets are scaled by budget_scale and must stay within the configured limits. Previews unless confirm=true. Review in Ads Manager, then enable with snap_set_status. Two steps: confirm=false returns a preview and an approval_token; to apply, repeat the same arguments with confirm=true and that approval_token. Use to duplicate a campaign (everything starts PAUSED). Not for copying one ad squad (snap_copy_adsquad) or one ad (snap_clone_ad).

approval_token.description: The approval_token returned by the preview of this exact request. Required with confirm=true.

budget_scale.description: Multiply every daily and lifetime budget, e.g. 0.5 for half

campaign_id.description: Campaign id. Get it from snap_list_campaigns.

confirm.description: false = preview only (nothing sent). true = apply; needs approval_token from the preview.

include_ads.description: true = copy the ads too (they start PAUSED).

new_name.description: Name for the copy or the new name for the item.

resume_campaign_id.description: Reuse an empty campaign left by a failed copy instead of creating a new one

squad_ids.description: Copy only these ad squads of the source campaign

name: snap_copy_campaign
